input.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: Customer has a consent-free affiliate/successor assignment right; Vendor needs Customer's consent (reasonableness qualified) and may never assign to a Customer competitor; and §24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing or acceleration right on Customer's change of control.
